title: Architecture
text: Current. ducksemantics owns ontology graphs, HPO extraction observations, release-cataloged Monarch gene/phenotype/disease relations, semantic literature retrieval, source-grounded judgments, real model/provider protocols. Bulk values data frames caller-owned DuckDB relations; S7 reserved prompt, embedding, parser, annotator provider protocols. RClinVarbitration owns ClinVar append-PubMed/Europe PMC source relations; ducksemantics consumes caller-owned source-order literature projection without writing copy. VariantStoryBench owns evaluation benchmark APIs. semantic authority documented relational contracts validators: lexical HPO candidates observations; observations validate exact source spans; Monarch facts retain provider/release identity typed catalog; literature retrieval binds provider plus exact cataloged source-order cutoff, selects article’s latest event, drops deletion events, joins event’s sections.

title: DuckDB-Native Semantic and Retrieval Relations
text: Lexical candidates intentionally distinct accepted observations. accepted observation must carry HPO identifier, exact zero-based half-open source span, context, method/provider provenance, confidence, explicit accepted status. validator rejects hallucinated text, empty spans, --bounds spans, context outside present, absent/negated, family_history, uncertain, conflict, unsupported.
code: library(ducksemantics)  documents <- data.frame(   document_id = "case-001",   source_text = "The patient has seizures.",   stringsAsFactors = FALSE )  observations <- data.frame(   document_id = "case-001",   hpo_id = "HP:0001250",   start_offset = 16L,   end_offset = 24L,   source_text = "seizures",   context_status = "present",   method = "lexical_alias",   provider_id = "local-lexicon",   provider_version = "1",   confidence = 1,   status = "accepted",   stringsAsFactors = FALSE )  ducksemantics_hpo_observations(documents, observations) ##   document_id     hpo_id start_offset end_offset source_text context_status ## 1    case-001 HP:0001250           16         24    seizures        present ##          method   provider_id provider_version confidence   status ## 1 lexical_alias local-lexicon                1          1 accepted

title: DuckDB-Native Semantic and Retrieval Relations
text: Callers provide facts typed release catalog. catalog row identifies one provider/release supplies Date/POSIXct effective date numeric source ordinal. Exact -queries bind provider plus cataloged release; historical gene-disease holdouts explicit anti-join audits.
code: releases <- data.frame(   release_id = c("2024-01", "2025-01"),   provider_id = "Monarch",   effective_date = as.Date(c("2024-01-01", "2025-01-01")),   source_ordinal = c(1, 2),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) gene_disease <- data.frame(   gene_id = c("HGNC:1100", "HGNC:1100"),   disease_id = c("MONDO:0000001", "MONDO:0000002"),   release_id = c("2024-01", "2025-01"),   provider_id = "Monarch",   stringsAsFactors = FALSE )  gene_disease <- ducksemantics_monarch_import(   gene_disease, releases, relation = "gene_disease" ) ducksemantics_monarch_gene_disease_holdout_audit(   gene_disease, releases, provider_id = "Monarch",   train_release_id = "2024-01", holdout_release_id = "2025-01" ) ##     gene_id    disease_id               predicate release_id provider_id ## 1 HGNC:1100 MONDO:0000002 biolink:associated_with    2025-01     Monarch ##   source_version attrs train_release_id holdout_release_id ## 1           <NA>  <NA>          2024-01            2025-01

title: DuckDB-Native Semantic and Retrieval Relations
text: RClinVarbitration owns append-PubMed source history ducksemantics neither imports stores literature. Retrieval consumes provider-scoped source-order projection: snapshots: provider_id, snapshot_id, finite integer high_water_ordinal, optional POSIXct effective_at; article versions: provider_id, article_id, pmid, version_id, finite integer source_ordinal, logical is_deleted; version-bound sections: provider_id, article_id, pmid, version_id, finite integer source_ordinal, section, exact non-empty text. cataloged provider/snapshot, selects maximum source_ordinal <= high_water_ordinal per article, excludes article selected event deleted, joins sections version keys. Thus order numeric (example 10 follows 9), lexical. Exact nonempty zero-based half-open source spans returned. directly derivable RClinVarbitration without storage adapter: pubmed_sources supplies provider, snapshot, source ordinal, application timestamp; pubmed_articles supplies event deletion flag; pubmed_abstracts supplies -source version-bound sections. caller may also project article_title title section. relations remain caller-owned; ducksemantics write materialize shadow copy.
code: snapshots <- data.frame(   provider_id = c("pubmed", "pubmed"),   snapshot_id = c("baseline", "update"),   high_water_ordinal = c(9, 10),   effective_at = as.POSIXct(c("2025-01-09", "2025-01-10"), tz = "UTC"),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) articles <- data.frame(   provider_id = "pubmed",   article_id = c("pmid:123", "pmid:123"),   pmid = "123",   version_id = c("source-9", "source-10"),   source_ordinal = c(9, 10),   is_deleted = c(FALSE, FALSE),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) sections <- data.frame(   provider_id = "pubmed",   article_id = c("pmid:123", "pmid:123"),   pmid = "123",   version_id = c("source-9", "source-10"),   source_ordinal = c(9, 10),   section = "BACKGROUND",   text = c("Seizure phenotype in a family", "Updated seizure phenotype"),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE )  ducksemantics_literature_retrieve(   articles, sections, snapshots,   query = "seizure",   provider_id = "pubmed",   snapshot_id = "update" ) ##   provider_id snapshot_id high_water_ordinal effective_at article_id pmid ## 1      pubmed      update                 10   2025-01-10   pmid:123  123 ##   version_id source_ordinal    section start_offset end_offset source_text ## 1  source-10             10 BACKGROUND            8         15     seizure ##                section_text ## 1 Updated seizure phenotype

ducksemantics 0.1.0
text: Sealed package ownership around ontology graphs, validated HPO observations, typed release-cataloged Monarch relations, snapshot-catalog-bound literature retrieval, source-grounded semantic/provider protocols. Added final relational HPO observation contract. validates exact, non-empty zero-based half-open source spans records context, method, provider identity/version, confidence, explicit accepted status. Added caller-supplied Monarch gene-phenotype/gene-disease facts required typed provider/release catalog. Exact Date/order -queries reject unknown releases; historical gene-disease holdouts provenance-preserving anti-join audits. Literature retrieval now consumes RClinVarbitration’s caller-owned append-source-order projection: cataloged integer cutoffs select latest article event, discard latest deletion events, join exact -version sections returning source spans. ducksemantics neither imports stores literature relations. Removed ducksemantics benchmark APIs (owned VariantStoryBench), generic cache APIs, S7 wrappers relations, connections, matrices, batches, queries, indexes, clustering specifications. Embedding reranking now use ordinary data frames, matrices, scalar arguments.
